cardholder_claim: I do not recognise this charge. I have never shopped at this store, and my card has been in my wallet the whole time. Nobody else uses my card.
Three game credit purchases appeared overnight. I do not play this game and never gave my card details to anyone. I think my card number was stolen.
My dinner bill was 48.20 and I signed the receipt for that amount, but my statement shows 84.20. I have a photo of the signed receipt.
I filled up my car once, but I was charged 62.35 twice on the same day, two minutes apart. I only made one purchase.
I ordered flowers online but chose to pay in cash at pickup, and I have the cash receipt. The shop charged my card for the same order anyway.
I ordered a sofa with delivery promised by 1 March. It is now six weeks later and nothing has arrived. The merchant stopped answering my emails.
Tracking says my jacket was delivered but I never received it. The merchant said they would refund me once the courier confirmed it was lost. Two weeks later I have no jacket and no refund.
I cancelled my monthly streaming plan on 10 March and have the cancellation email. I was still billed 15.99 on 1 April.
I placed one order for a meal kit box and cancelled it online before it shipped. They charged me anyway. Their site calls it a subscription, but I only ever placed this single order.
The blender arrived with a cracked jug and the motor does not run. The listing said brand new. I sent photos and the merchant refuses to take it back.
I returned the shoes and the merchant emailed me a refund confirmation for 95.50 on 2 May. Twenty days later the credit still has not reached my card.
I booked movers by phone and cancelled five days before the move. Their policy allows free cancellation up to 48 hours before, but they kept my 300 deposit.
